applies_to: a future frozen source epoch, not scale-v2 artifacts
artifact_tracking_decision: Track the archival JSON and this verifier under docs/puct-teacher-control-v1/. The original lane was target-only and never-merge. These files are reviewable evidence, not a gameplay source change and not an epoch-over-epoch result.
denominator_rule: Every arm keeps the full held-out evaluation-root denominator. Truncation and error are not-wins and remain explicitly classified. Non-error HP and clean terminal HP subsets are not the official win denominator.

evaluation_provenance.note: Both students are evaluated on the same fresh held-out roots. Evaluation provenance is not the training manifest.

controlled_label_treatment_ab.purpose: Isolate the teacher-label treatment. The baseline student is trained on beam labels; the treatment student is trained on PUCT labels.

training_provenance.note: Training manifests may differ only because the label teacher differs. Training roots, cohort, encoder, vocabulary, init, budget, and native bundle must match.

evaluation_provenance.note: Previous agent and new student run on the same fresh held-out roots.

system_iteration_comparison.purpose: Compare the previous agent to the new student. Useful, but not a pure causal estimate of the label treatment.

training_provenance.note: Ordinary expert iteration trains the new student on newly generated labels, so training manifests naturally differ from the previous agent.

forbidden_shortcuts: treating training-manifest equality as the evaluation control
calling uniform-prior network-value PUCT an unguided baseline
native rebuild to chase an old digest

puct_search_contract.stop: first exhausted of simulation_budget or transition_budget

tie_breaking.in_tree_edge_selection: PUCT score uses strict greater-than; lowest public-action index wins ties
tie_breaking.root_action_selection: visit count uses strict greater-than; lowest public-action index wins ties

scale_v2_identity_facts.note: The two frozen checkpoints share source and runtime identities with each other. Both differ from the later rebuilt native runtime. They also differ from each other in training cohort, vocabulary, and encoder contract.

leaf_value.note: no network prior and no network value; only combat_proxy_v1 at true terminals
uses the checkpoint value head; this is not unguided PUCT

uniform_prior_network_value_puct.role: policy-prior ablation, not an unguided baseline
